column1: # Cross-stage mod-order divergences that are the pin's randomised order, excluded from TestModOrderCensus's ceiling.
# A pair is listed when the pin's own order for that (actor, build, mod name) is not one sequence: run
# oracle/mod_order_stability.lua with pads 0, 1000, 54321 and 7 (each pad shifts LuaJIT's allocation and so the order of
# every pairs() over a table keyed by objects) and the runs disagree with each other ("unstable") or all agree with
# ours while the dump does not ("dump-differs"). The census fails on a listed pair that no longer diverges.
# "unstable-more-pads" needed pads 3, 17, 250, 333, 4096, 20000, 77777 and 100000 as well to show a second order.
